package rulefixtures

// scenario for go_perf_layer_collection_iteration_len_called_after_materializing_channel: Layer: Collection iteration. Flag channel streams collected into slices only to measure length or emptiness.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.

func collectFromChannel(ch <-chan int) []int {
	var items []int
	for v := range ch {
		items = append(items, v)
	}
	return items
}

func scenario515Positive(ch <-chan int) int {
	items := collectFromChannel(ch)
	return len(items)
}
